notes.title: ENIGMARELLA FULL RELEASE !!
notes.content: We are thrilled and really happy to be able to share with you the completion of an 8 year old journey. What started as a two-person, crazy endeavor has finally turned into a reality thanks to a wonderful team of people, who believed in us and shared our passion to bring Enigmarella to life.
